d: Company Description Traders Hub Currency Brokerage provides online traders with secure, easy access to a broad range of asset classes, including Forex, Commodities, Indices, Shares, and ETFs via Contracts for Difference (CFDs). The firm delivers tight, competitive spreads and uses market-leading technology to support both new and experienced traders. Traders Hub offers several account types designed to meet diverse trading needs and preferences. The company is licensed by the Securities and Commodities Authority (SCA) in the United Arab Emirates to deal in securities, including OTC derivatives and spot market currencies (License no. 20200000030). This regulatory framework underscores its commitment to compliant, secure, and transparent trading services.

Role Description The Cybersecurity Engineer – Designs, implements and maintains technical security controls protecting company systems, data and client information; secures infrastructure, cloud and applications, monitors threats, responds to incidents and supports UAE regulatory compliance.
Design, deploy and maintain firewalls, VPN, IDS/IPS, EDR, email security and web filtering.
Harden servers, endpoints, network devices and cloud environments using security baselines such as CIS Benchmarks.
Embed security into new systems, integrations and vendor connections before go-live.
Set up, tune and manage SIEM and log monitoring across critical systems.
Monitor alerts daily, investigate suspicious activity and reduce false positives.
Build detection rules and alerts for threats relevant to financial services.
Lead technical incident containment, investigation, recovery and root cause analysis.
Maintain incident response playbooks and conduct regular drills.
Document incidents and support management and regulatory reporting.
Conduct regular vulnerability scans of infrastructure, web applications and mobile applications.
Remediate vulnerabilities or coordinate fixes with IT and vendors within agreed timelines.
Support external penetration testing and closure of findings.
Implement and manage MFA, SSO and privileged access controls.
Perform regular access reviews and ensure leavers’ access is promptly removed.
Secure cloud, Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace, Salesforce and other SaaS configurations.
Protect against phishing, spoofing and data leakage using SPF, DKIM, DMARC and DLP.
Work with developers and vendors on secure configuration and coding practices.
Implement encryption, data classification and secure retention controls.
Secure backups and test restoration and disaster recovery with the IT team.
Implement controls supporting UAE PDPL, SCA requirements and internal policies, aligned with ISO 27001 / NIST CSF.
Provide technical evidence for audits and regulatory inspections.
Conduct phishing simulations and support staff security training.
Prepare monthly security reports for management.
Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, IT or a related field.
Preferred certifications: CompTIA Security+, CEH, OSCP, CCNP Security, Microsoft SC-200 / AZ-500, or CISSP.
At least 4 years of hands-on cybersecurity engineering experience, preferably in financial services or a regulated industry.
Firewalls (Fortinet, Palo Alto, Sophos or similar), VPN and IDS/IPS.
SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Wazuh or similar) and EDR (Defender, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne or similar).
Vulnerability tools (Nessus, Qualys, OpenVAS) and basic penetration testing.
Windows, Linux, Active Directory / Entra ID hardening.
Cloud and Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace security.
Scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python or Bash.
Knowledge of UAE data protection and financial regulations.
